hinweis: Alle ElevenLabs-Klänge von Seelenstein. tools/klang-erzeugen.py erzeugt fehlende Rohdateien (Schlüssel aus ELK) und baut daraus snd/sfx, snd/musik und js/daten/klang-dateien.js. Felder: prompt, dauer (s), einfluss (prompt_influence), teile (1 = ganze Datei ein Laut), behalten (Indizes der gefundenen Laute), anzahl, max (s), hp (Hochpass Hz), schwelle/ausklang/luecke (Schnitt), lufs (Ziel-Kurzzeitlautheit), rollen (Ereignis → Laut-Indizes), quelle (aus anderer Rohdatei), aus (nicht verwenden).

musik.prompt: Calm, warm and relaxing fantasy village town theme for an RPG, gently East Asian inspired. Soft plucked guzheng and koto arpeggios, a breathy bamboo flute (dizi) playing a gentle pentatonic melody, warm string pad, soft low bass, light hand percussion and a quiet wooden block, a little chime. Peaceful, chill, cozy, sunny afternoon in a lantern-lit market town. 72 BPM, D major pentatonic, steady and even throughout, no big build-ups, no ending, loopable. Instrumental only, no vocals.

Serene, chill and gentle fantasy town music for an RPG with a soft East Asian touch. Slow koto and guzheng plucks with lots of space, a warm soft bamboo flute melody, a mellow erhu answering now and then, lush warm pad, deep soft bass, very light brushed hand drum and wind chimes. Relaxing, cozy, peaceful, lo-fi warmth, golden evening light over a lantern-lit town. 66 BPM, G major pentatonic, consistent mood throughout, no build-up, no ending, loopable. Instrumental only, no vocals.

Calm, mysterious enchanted forest exploration music for a fantasy RPG with a subtle East Asian touch. A soft erhu melody in a minor pentatonic mode, gentle guzheng harmonics, airy shakuhachi-like breathy flute, warm low strings, soft distant wooden percussion, light bird-like flute ornaments. Peaceful but slightly melancholic, dappled light under ancient trees. 64 BPM, A minor, steady throughout, no ending, loopable. Instrumental only, no vocals.

Cold, crystalline and lonely snowy mountain music for a fantasy RPG. Delicate celesta and glass bells, a slow airy bamboo flute melody, soft sustained high strings, a low distant drone, sparse koto notes with long reverb, a gentle wind texture. Quiet, frozen, beautiful and still. 58 BPM, E minor, consistent throughout, no ending, loopable. Instrumental only, no vocals.

Hot desert and volcanic wasteland exploration music for a fantasy RPG. A hypnotic hand drum and frame drum groove, plucked oud-like and guzheng patterns in a phrygian mode, a smoky low reed melody, low droning strings, shimmering heat. Mysterious, warm and adventurous but not aggressive. 80 BPM, D phrygian, steady throughout, no ending, loopable. Instrumental only, no vocals.

Dark, ominous dungeon and haunted swamp ambience music for a fantasy RPG. Low cello drones, slow deep taiko hits far away, soft dissonant string clusters, a breathy low bamboo flute playing a sparse sad melody, eerie metallic scrapes and distant chimes, heavy reverb. Tense, brooding and mysterious, never loud. 54 BPM, G minor, consistent throughout, no ending, loopable. Instrumental only, no vocals.

Epic, intense boss battle music for a fantasy RPG with an East Asian flavour. Full orchestra with a driving staccato string ostinato, powerful taiko and war drums, heroic brass stabs, a wordless choir singing sustained 'aah' chords inside the orchestra (no lyrics, no solo singer), fierce erhu and bamboo flute lines over the orchestra. Dramatic, relentless, high energy throughout. 140 BPM, D minor, starts immediately at full intensity, no ending, loopable.
